# Build Red-DiscordBot

Clones Red-DiscordBot at optional commit, builds it using uv, and uploads the artifact.

## Inputs

| Input | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `red_commit` | ❌ | — | Optional commit SHA for Red-DiscordBot. If omitted, main is used. |
| `artifact_name` | ❌ | — | Optional artifact name. Default: red-discordbot-build |
